name: git
description: Git 2.39.5 with Perl helpers and exact Debian Bookworm runtime dependencies.
license: Upstream licenses included in usr/share/doc/*/copyright (GPL, LGPL, BSD, MIT and others)
notes: Debian Bookworm main packages pinned from verified Packages.xz indices. GizMoth extracts data payloads only; no maintainer scripts run. Release 12.0.1 keeps the 12.0.0 upstream inputs but installs Git and Perl under the versioned package prefix, exports usr/bin through managed activation, redirects Git/Perl data and private library paths, and adjusts local Perl script shebangs. The runtime and network library dependencies remain guest-root layers.
